item.title: Suns vs Spurs: Ultimate Season Series Breakdown and What It Means for the Western Conference
item.description:
Devin Booker averaged 33.9 points per game over his last seven appearances heading into the final Suns vs Spurs matchup of the season — and yet Phoenix’s defense has been so porous that putting up 30-plus still might not be enough.

The Phoenix Suns and San Antonio Spurs wrapped up their four-game regular-season series on March 19 at Frost Bank Center, capping a rivalry that has produced dramatic swings, monster stat lines, and serious playoff implications for both Western Conference squads.

item.title: Kevin Durant MVP Push: Rockets Star Dominates at 37 With Historic Scoring Streak
item.description: At 37 years old, most NBA players are winding down their careers, accepting reduced roles, and mentoring younger teammates from the bench. Kevin Durant didn’t get that memo. The Houston Rockets forward is in the middle of one of the most remarkable late-career surges in league history, climbing into the top 10 of the MVP ladder and reminding everyone why he’s considered one of the greatest scorers to ever touch a basketball.
